`final class SignalReplayCall`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.signal.replay` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SignalReplayCall.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/signal/replay/SignalReplayCall.java)

One setter call in the code of the application: the line of the caller and the name of the setter.

## Description

[`SignalReplay`](/reference/signals/signalreplay/) uses it as the key of its caches and to write its warnings.

## Learn more

- [How signals work](/use/in-depth/how-signals-work/)
